title: WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_REQUIRE_FIPS provides startup probe, not per-operation enforcement
description: Scenario: Operator enables WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_REQUIRE_FIPS expecting that every crypto operation is routed to a FIPS-validated provider. Bad behavior: the REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl is issued on a single probe fd that is immediately closed. Pool fds and g_crypto2dev_fd (ECDSA) are opened without REQUIRE_FIPS. The kernel's per-fd flag provides no enforcement on those fds. Maintenance consequence: operators building FIPS-compliant deployments will believe the flag provides per-operation enforcement; audit findings or CVEs will result when it doesn't. The in-code comment documents this correctly but the option name (REQUIRE_FIPS) implies stronger semantics than the implementation delivers.
